title: A one-coupling J-Schur certificate for projected spectral enclosures
exact_target: Develop reliable projected enclosures, distinguish isoresonant potentials, and classify operators with controlled resolvents.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002502 (AIM-PHYSICS-0010). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Mathematical aspects of physics with non-self-adjoint operators; workshop 8–12 June 2015, Problems 17.1–19.1.

status_qualification: The long counting bound in the PDF motivates the question rather than constituting an additional conjecture. All three requested classifications and both isoresonant settings are retained. J is not silently changed from conjugation to a linear indefinite-metric involution. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
